hero_title: Evaluate this collection with repeatable runs
hero_description: Curate evaluation datasets, add questions manually, then start an evaluation run against your bot in one place.
datasets_section_description: A dataset is a group of questions used to evaluate your bot. Create one and add items manually.
runs_section_description: Track recent evaluation runs for this collection, current progress, and outcome summaries.

empty_datasets_description: Create your first dataset and add at least one question to start evaluating this collection.
dataset_detail_description: Each question becomes a run item when an evaluation run is started. Questions remain mutable; runs take a value-copy snapshot.
add_question_description: A question is used as the user-facing input for an evaluation run item.
ai_generate_description: Draft QA pairs from this knowledge base. Preview before saving into the dataset.

ai_generate_collection_missing: Dataset has no associated knowledge base; AI generation unavailable
ai_generate_no_collection: Dataset has no associated knowledge base; AI generation unavailable
input_message_placeholder: Enter the user prompt the bot should answer
delete_question_confirm: Delete this question from the dataset?
empty_items_description: Add at least one question before you can start an evaluation run.
create_dataset_missing_id: Dataset was created but no dataset id was returned
start_run_description: Select an evaluation dataset. The run automatically uses your default evaluation bot.
